description: This file defines functions for importing CSS files and dynamically injecting CSS into a webpage using Lua code. It includes utility functions for reading files, minifying CSS, and creating <style> elements in the DOM.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Reads a file from the given path and returns its contents.

methods.name: luax.css
methods.description: Concatenates multiple CSS sources, minifies them, and injects the resulting CSS into the webpage dynamically.
